announcement: BmoreCorny is BACK! What the Shuck?!
headline:
GOOD TIMES.
GREAT THROWS.
A LITTLE CORNY.
intro: Cornhole is the game. The people, the laughs, the ridiculous shots and the good we can do together? That's the whole point.
challengeText: One big idea. One unforgettable shot. The official challenge details, submission process and leaderboard are coming soon.
causeText: We're building a cornhole-powered way to bring people together and support causes worth showing up for. Beneficiary and fundraising details will be announced here.
experienceText: Backyard battles. Community events. Fundraisers. Friendly rivalries. Corny jokes that should probably stay in the group chat. If it brings people together, we're interested.
footerLine: THROW BIG. DO GOOD. STAY CORNY.
